## Why This Is Asked

This question assesses practical implementation knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation systems, focusing on key engineering decisions including chunking strategies, embedding model selection, vector database integration, and performance optimization in real-world QA applications.

## Key Concepts

- Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
- Document chunking strategies and overlap optimization
- Embedding model selection and dimensionality

- Cosine similarity-based retrieval
- Lightweight reranking techniques
- LLM integration for answer synthesis

const embeddings = embedChunks(chunks, embeddingModel);

- Tokenization boundaries and subword vs whole-token attention
- Attention distribution diagnostics (KL divergence, entropy)
- Lightweight dynamic vocabulary fallback without retraining

## Code Example

```python
# toy: compare two attention maps and print KL difference
import numpy as np
def kl(p, q):
    p = np.asarray(p, dtype=float)
    q = np.asarray(q, dtype=float)
    p = p / p.sum()
    q = q / q.sum()
    return float(np.sum(p * np.log(p / (q + 1e-9))))
```

## Why This Question Matters

This question evaluates practical knowledge of deploying Transformers in production environments with streaming data, emphasizing memory constraints, latency considerations, and tokenization strategies at scale.

## Key Concepts

- **Memory-efficient attention (FlashAttention)**: Reduces quadratic attention complexity and GPU memory usage
- **KV caching**: Stores computed keys and values to avoid redundant computation across overlapping windows
- **Causal masking**: Ensures each position only attends to previous positions, preserving autoregressive properties
- **Rotary position embeddings**: Extends effective context length without linear growth in positional encoding overhead
- **Streaming tokenization**: Tokenizes logs incrementally as they arrive, preserving event order via timestamps
- **Windowed processing**: Enables processing of multi-terabyte logs by dividing them into manageable rolling windows
